incomplete.title: Receipts can't be issued until the receipt settings are complete, so no pass can be sold.
incomplete.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to complete them.

settings.title: Receipts
settings.description: What every receipt prints: the issuer, the tax details and the number. Changes apply to later receipts; issued ones stay as they are.
settings.loadError: The receipt settings could not be loaded.
settings.saved: The receipt settings have been saved.
settings.savedIncomplete: The receipt settings have been saved, but receipts still can't be issued.
settings.taxNoteHint: Printed on every receipt; needed when the school is exempt from VAT, naming the legal basis.
settings.footerHint: Printed at the bottom, e.g. bank details.
settings.prefixHint: Starts every receipt number, e.g. SD for SD-2026-0001: 1 to 16 letters A–Z and digits.
settings.notCashRegister: Receipts confirm payments; this app is not a cash register. This is not tax advice.

taxModeHints.small_business: No VAT is charged; receipts print the small business note (or the tax note).
taxModeHints.exempt: No VAT is charged; receipts print the tax note, which names the legal basis.
taxModeHints.standard: The VAT rate of each pass type is included in its price; receipts print net and VAT.

logo.title: Logo
logo.invalid: Choose a PNG or JPEG image of at most {{size}} KB.
logo.hint: A PNG or JPEG of at most {{size}} KB, printed at the top of later receipts.
logo.unreadable: The file could not be read; choose it again.

list.title: Receipts
list.description: The receipts of the pass sales and their cancellations, newest first. Receipts are never changed: a mistake is canceled, which voids the pass if it was not used.

detail.title: Receipt
detail.loadError: The receipt could not be loaded.
detail.description: As it was issued; the PDF is the original.

download.label: Download receipt {{number}} as PDF
download.failed: The receipt could not be downloaded.

cancel.title: Cancel receipt {{number}}?
cancel.description: A cancellation receipt with the next number is issued and mailed to the payer, and the pass is voided. This cannot be undone.
cancel.passUsed: The pass has paid for visits, so its receipt cannot be canceled. Void the pass on the person's page instead.
cancel.eventAttended: A session of the event has started, so this receipt is canceled only with the registration, with a refund.
cancel.alreadyCanceled: This receipt has been canceled already.
cancel.done: Cancellation {{number}} has been issued; the pass is voided.
